Class TargetInterceptors

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.aop.chain.TargetInterceptors
@Internal public final class TargetInterceptors extends Object
The interceptors one proxy selected for each target it fronts. A proxy that selects for its target keeps one of these instead of an array of its own, because it can front many targets: a scoped proxy sees a different one for every scope instance, a hot-swappable one sees each target swapped in.

Three objects take part:

  • the proxy, which has exactly one of these, in a field, for as long as it lives;
  • a target, the real bean instance a call is delegated to, and its dependencies: the record of what was created for that one instance and is destroyed with it;
  • the interceptors of a target, one array for each proxied method.

What happens to them:

  1. On the first call for a target its interceptors are selected. The unscoped ones are created as dependents of the target, not of the proxy, so that they are the instances the lifecycle of the target was intercepted with and are destroyed with it.
  2. The selection is kept here, with the proxy, and returned for every later call for that target.
  3. Together with the interceptors, the target is given one more dependent, a TargetInterceptors.Removal. When the target is destroyed, so is the removal, which takes the selection of that target out of this proxy.
  4. A target that cannot own interceptors, because nothing would destroy them with it, is intercepted with interceptors the proxy owns. They are selected once and destroyed with the proxy.
Since:
5.3.0

      public Interceptor<?,?>[][] resolve(@Nullable BeanRegistration<?> targetRegistration, @Nullable Object targetBean)
      Returns the interceptors of a target, selecting them on the first call for it. A generated proxy calls this on every intercepted call, with the target it is about to delegate to.
      Parameters:
      targetRegistration - The registration of the target bean, not of the proxy; null if the context holds none for the instance
      targetBean - The target instance the proxy is calling
      Returns:
      The interceptors selected for each proxied method
